shellCommands.command: git rm -r --quiet pages && git status --short && ls -R app

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; curl -sf http://localhost:3111/ >/dev/null && break; done; echo "=== / ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE '[^<]*||]*>|

[^<]*

|]*>[^<]*|]*>'; echo "=== /about ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/about | grep -oE '[^<]*||]*>|

[^<]*

|]*>[^<]*'; echo "=== status codes ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "/ %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "/about %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/about
pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; sleep 1; echo killed; git status --short; echo "--- tsconfig diff ---"; git diff -- tsconfig.json
sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 http://localhost:3111/ || echo "server down"; git status --short; echo "--- tsconfig diff ---"; git diff -- tsconfig.json
git diff -- tsconfig.json; echo "=== rebuild ==="; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "=== post-build tsconfig diff ==="; git diff -- tsconfig.json; echo "=== status ==="; git status --short

(npx next dev -p 3112 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; curl -sf http://localhost:3112/ >/dev/null && break; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "dev / %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3112/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "dev /about %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3112/about; grep -iE "error|warn" /tmp/dev.log | head -5; pkill -f "next dev"; pkill -f next-server; true
